payload.name: Knee push-ups
instructionSteps: Hands under shoulders, knees down, body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lower chest toward the floor, elbows at ~45°.
Push back up without letting hips sag.

payload.name: Push-ups
instructionSteps: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower until chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up, keeping core tight throughout.

payload.name: Diamond push-ups
instructionSteps: Hands together under chest, forming a diamond with thumbs/index fingers.
Lower chest toward hands, elbows tracking back.
Press back up under control.

payload.name: Wall push-ups
instructionSteps: Stand arm's length from a wall, palms flat on it at shoulder height.
Bend elbows to bring chest toward the wall.
Push back to start.

payload.name: Pike push-ups
instructionSteps: Hips high in an inverted-V, hands shoulder-width.
Bend elbows to lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up.

payload.name: Bodyweight squats
instructionSteps: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit hips back and down as if reaching for a chair, chest up.
Drive through heels to stand back up.

payload.name: Walking lunges
instructionSteps: Step forward, lowering back knee toward the floor.
Front knee stays over the ankle, not past the toes.
Push off the front foot to step into the next lunge.

payload.name: Jump squats
instructionSteps: Perform a normal squat.
Explode upward into a jump at the top.
Land softly, bending knees to absorb impact, and reset.

payload.name: Glute bridges
instructionSteps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze glutes to lift hips until body forms a straight line knee-to-shoulder.
Lower with control.

payload.name: Calf raises
instructionSteps: Stand tall, feet hip-width.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Lower slowly under control.

payload.name: Plank
instructionSteps: Forearms and toes on the floor, elbows under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from head to heels, core braced.
Hold for the timer without letting hips sag or pike.

payload.name: Bicycle crunches
instructionSteps: Lie on back, hands lightly behind head, knees bent.
Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee in a pedaling motion.
Keep lower back pressed toward the floor.

payload.name: Hollow body hold
instructionSteps: Lie on back, arms overhead, legs extended.
Lift shoulders and legs off the floor, lower back pressed down.
Hold the 'banana' shape for the timer.

payload.name: Dead bug
instructionSteps: Lie on back, arms up, knees bent at 90°.
Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to start and alternate sides, keeping the back flat.

payload.name: Side plank
instructionSteps: Lie on your side, propped on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift hips so the body forms a straight line.
Hold for the timer, then switch sides.

payload.name: March in place
instructionSteps: Stand tall and lift knees alternately at a steady pace.
Pump arms naturally.
Keep going for the full timer.

payload.name: Jumping jacks
instructionSteps: Start with feet together, arms at sides.
Jump feet out while raising arms overhead.
Jump back to start and repeat at a steady rhythm.

payload.name: High knees
instructionSteps: Run in place, driving knees up toward hip height.
Pump arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep a quick, light cadence for the full interval.

payload.name: Burpees
instructionSteps: From standing, drop into a squat and place hands on the floor.
Kick feet back to a plank, then return them to your hands.
Stand and jump, then repeat immediately.

payload.name: Mountain climbers
instructionSteps: Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders.
Drive knees alternately toward your chest at a quick pace.
Keep hips low and core braced throughout.

payload.name: Cat-cow stretch
instructionSteps: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.
Arch your back, dropping belly (cow), then round it, tucking chin (cat).
Move slowly between the two, syncing with your breath.

payload.name: Hip openers (world's greatest stretch)
instructionSteps: Step into a deep lunge, both hands inside the front foot.
Rotate your torso and reach the same-side arm toward the ceiling.
Return and switch sides, moving slowly.

payload.name: Shoulder pass-throughs
instructionSteps: Hold a towel or band with a wide overhand grip.
Slowly raise it overhead and behind your back, keeping arms straight.
Bring it back to the front with control.

payload.name: Standing quad stretch
instructionSteps: Stand tall, balance on one leg (hold a wall if needed).
Grab the other ankle and gently pull the heel toward your glutes.
Hold, keeping knees close together, then switch sides.

payload.name: Thoracic rotations
instructionSteps: Start on hands and knees, one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling, following it with your eyes.
Return and repeat, then switch sides.
